testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.lw.DeleteOnQuitGuardTest

testcase.name: history deletion without tabs asks the restore to drop back-forward history
a deletion that keeps killing the process is retried a bounded number of times
no history purge without HISTORY or without a deletion
marker round-trips and leaves no temporary file
a failing directory fsync does not fail the write
a local step that never returns does not hold the main thread
the gate bound counts from the start of the deletion and fails open
quit marks clean only after the deletion is confirmed
foreground without a preceding quit writes nothing
clean quit skips the deletion and marks the new session running
engine that never answers does not hold restore forever
app-side failure is contained
absent marker reads as null
session end with the setting off does nothing
startup decision table
every activity start counts, not only the first one of the process
unclean exit deletes before restore and records the attempt first
setting off deletes nothing whatever the marker says
unreadable or unknown marker content counts as unclean
quit whose deletion fails stays unclean
returning to the foreground before the deletion finished keeps the marker unclean
a torn temporary file never replaces the marker
the directory is fsynced after the rename
missing marker with the setting on counts as unclean
